sections.heading: Meet Christopher Hill AKA “Maximus Khan”
sections.intro: Christopher Hill is a coach, mentor, and man who walked through the same struggles many men face:
sections.afterList: Through discipline, faith, and surrender to God, he rebuilt his life from the inside out.
sections.quote: “Maximus Khan” represents the disciplined, courageous man every man is called to become. It reflects strength under control, mastery over the flesh, courage rooted in obedience, and leadership under God.
sections.afterQuote: WAKE UP was built from lived experience — not theory.

scriptures.text: “Whoever rules his spirit is better than one who takes a city.”
“Be strong and courageous… for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.”
